reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonBusinessDay helper that getNextDate and getDateWithSkippedWeekend already share, but does not make the getDatesInRange handler use it.

duplication.why: The diff itself adds no copy, but it leaves the pre-existing inline holiday check in server/schedules/app.ts (getDatesInRange daily branch) as a separate, now divergent copy.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule is changed in the shared schedules util where non-business days are defined.

scope.why: A minimal change to one helper plus a focused test.

maintainability.why: Clean and readable, but the daily path of schedule/get-dates-in-range still uses config.holidays?.includes(...) and so does not honour MM-DD entries, leaving the holiday rule in two places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change goes through isNonBusinessDay; the inline check in server/schedules/app.ts was already there and is merely left untouched.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated by the diff.
